extension.description: TreeATE V3.0 compatible project explorer, parameter editor and runner
config.testEnginePath.description: Absolute path to TreeATE TestEngine.exe; when empty, the project directory and PATH are searched automatically.
config.testEngineArguments.description: Arguments passed to TestEngine. Supports ${tpx}, ${projectDir}, and ${projectName}.
config.qtInspectorPath.description: Path to treeate-qt-inspector.exe; when empty, the bundled native/bin/treeate-qt-inspector.exe is used.
config.openScriptOnSelect.description: Automatically jump to the associated script function when a test suite or test case is selected.
config.language.description: Display language for extension panels and dialogs. Menus and command titles follow the VS Code display language; "auto" follows the VS Code display language as well.
